marta_csops: Noticed a spike of "nudge echoes" from the onboarding playbook over the last ~2.5h. Same account getting repeat nudges within minutes. Sample ids: acct-8811 x3, acct-9002 x2. Not normal.

raj_dataeng: ack. Any recent config pushes to the scheduler or backoff window?

marta_csops: Yes, we rolled a small change to the cron backoff at 02:40 UTC. I think overlapping schedules are firing.

playbook-bot: system: playbook run run-2024-07-05-02-40 started (onboard-welcome-v3). 1.5k candidates evaluated.

lina_enablement: Customer-facing impact? any complaints or CSAT hits?

marta_csops: So far 4 Intercom threads flagged duplicates and one customer asked to stop the messages. No wide CSAT hit yet but we should pause.

daniel_csm: Pause first, then investigate. Can someone flip the master toggle? I prefer manual hold rather than an immediate auto-toggle.

marta_csops: Agreed. Command to pause via admin API: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood-inference.internal/api/playbooks/enable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"playbook":"onboard-welcome-v3","enabled":false}'
```

marta_csops: Paused the send path and set playbook to "shadow_only" for now. Outbound email queue is draining.

raj_dataeng: I'll run two quick diffs: 1) find overlapping scheduled_at windows; 2) surface event duplicates. Use these queries: 

```sql
-- overlapping schedules
SELECT id, scheduled_at, started_at
FROM playbook_runs
WHERE name = 'onboard-welcome-v3' AND scheduled_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
ORDER BY scheduled_at;

-- duplicates
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM playbook_events
WHERE playbook_name = 'onboard-welcome-v3'
  AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

raj_dataeng: Preliminary result: one run (run-2024-07-05-02-40) and a retry job (run-2024-07-05-02-42) scheduled due to a follow-up patch in the CI pump. Delta between scheduled_at was 1m which is below our intended min_interval (5m).

lina_enablement: I'll draft a short apology/snippet for customers who received duplicates: "Apologies for duplicate onboarding messages. We've paused automated nudges and your CSM will follow up." Want me to also include a link to an unsubscribe preference?

daniel_csm: include unsubscribe link and mention we've paused automation. Keep it brief.

marta_csops: Proposal: add a gating rule to the playbook so it only sends nudges when account health_score >= 35 OR when last_active < 7 days (to catch recently active accounts). Also add a dedupe guard that suppresses send if account received same template in past 48 hours. Sample gating snippet below: 

```json
{"playbook":"onboard-welcome-v3","gating":{"min_health_score":35,"recent_activity_days":7},"dedupe_window_hours":48,"shadow_run":true}
```

raj_dataeng: I'll implement a CI lint that rejects schedule changes that create a scheduled_at delta < min_interval (configurable per playbook). Also adding a telemetry alert: if duplicates_detected > 50 in 1h, send a message to #csops and trigger a manual review pager. Not auto toggle.

marta_csops: That alert sounds good. Let's keep auto-toggle off for now.

lina_enablement: Outreach plan: CSMs handle accounts with >=3 duplicates. CS Ops will follow up for the rest. I'll update the tracker and add owners.

daniel_csm: For the short-term mitigation, can we run a one-hour backfill to see who got extra nudges and prepare personalized outreach?

raj_dataeng: Yes. I can produce a report: account_id, owner, nudge_count, last_sent_ts. Will post a CSV in the tracker channel within 30m.

playbook-bot: system: outbound queue drain complete. All sends halted.

marta_csops: Action items: 1) raj -> CI schedule delta check + duplicate query + CSV; 2) raj -> create alert rule (dupes > 50/hr) to #csops; 3) lina -> apology + CSM outreach template; 4) daniel -> confirm manual rollback policy and owner assignments. I'll set playbook to shadow-only until we validate.

daniel_csm: Thanks. Keep this thread updated when the CSV and alert are in place. :white_check_mark:

marta_csops: Will do. I'll post sample diffs between shadow run and previous send run once ready.
